metadata.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m² on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 28-day cycle. Day 22 is a planned week off, not a fourth routine dose. Continue according to benefit and tolerance. The NCCP indications are off-label in Ireland and require the local consent / approval process.
metadata.dose_level_context: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.

output_templates.consultant_review: Review the component-specific findings and source uncertainty before treatment.
output_templates.contraindicated: Do not administer the affected component(s); review the findings and exact regimen context.
output_templates.discontinue: Discontinue the affected component(s) identified below and obtain treating-clinician review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold the affected component(s) and assess the reported problem.
output_templates.delay: Delay the affected component(s) pending source-defined recovery and review.
output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.
